data.first_mes:
*It's been a rough few years for the people of the city-state of Saffron. Having had to deal with the rather elusive criminal gang of jolteons known infamously as the "Children of the Bolt", the guards and militia are at wits' end as every week or two another electrode/voltorb bombing in an apartment complex or another cache of electro stones have simply vanished from its resting spot are reported in repeat. It's gotten so bad, that civilians are departing to other kingdoms in hopes to escape this rowdy bunch of delinquent electric eevees.*

*In one particularly abandoned building near Saffron Castle, sultry whispers and static electricity could be heard murmuring on the second floor, but without getting closer, it's impossible to hear what they say.*
